$notes.seriesCapPolicy: v0.10.2: the categorical scale is CAPPED at 5 (--series-1..5, aliased to accent/steel/brandPurple/success/attention so they track theme). Beyond 5 is a re-encode signal: split charts, group the tail, or use the single-hue sequential --ramp-1..5 for magnitude.

$notes.ruleHexWithoutRatio: A hex without a ratio is not a decision. Any change to brandPurple* or any $roles.syntax.* binding MUST cite the resolved foreground hex AND the measured contrast against bg/bgRaised/ivory using scripts/contrast.mjs. Eyeballed contrast is the recurring root cause (3 incidents through v0.10.1).
$notes.ruleUsageSetsRatio: A ratio target without a usage is not a spec. The contrast a color MUST clear is a function of how it is USED and laid out, not the hue: a foreground glyph/text needs WCAG AA (4.5:1), but the same hue as an outline, fill, gradient stop, or chart series carries no text-contrast obligation. Tune the hue to the job — don't force one value to satisfy both. (Owner principle, 2026-05-31: 'readability of a dark purple is different than dark purple being an outline on a box.') Worked example: brandPurpleSurfaceSplit.

$notes.notificationSoundPolicy: Lane-1 ruling v0.20.0 (#93): SILENT BY DEFAULT. Notifications are visual-only — badge, dot, banner, tier color per attentionNotTextRole; no notification plays audio out of the box. Audible escalation exists only as a justified carve-out: it must (a) name the specific event class (e.g. urgent-tier build failure blocking the active task), (b) be opt-in or trivially disableable, and (c) never be the sole carrier of meaning — the visual tier signal must already be present (mirrors WCAG 1.4.1 logic: sound augments, never substitutes). A sound without a named event class and a visual twin is not a notification, it is noise.
$notes.typeOpticalPass: Lane-1 eyeball pass v0.20.0 (#214), post-re-true (~14% token-bound growth), rendered system reviewed 2026-07-11 (typography.html, components.html, both modes): NO REGRESSIONS. Headline scale (lg 28 / md 22) holds hierarchy; buttons, badges, status dots, inputs, accordion absorb the growth without wrapping or overflow; specimen and scan-hierarchy sections read correctly; small-caps section labels sit small relative to the grown body but legible and intentional. Ship as-is; details in themes/_research/lane1-278-ansiblack-ratification.md.

$notes.cmuxDiffVendorFallback: Lane-1 ruling v0.21.0 (#301, ACCEPTED FALLBACK — recorded trade, cousin of mutedGlyphFloor / paneInactiveSubAA). cmux derives diff-viewer file-status glyphs from the live ANSI palette (slots 2/10 green, 1/9 red) and enforces its own ~4.5:1 text floor; on terminalBg successBright #5fa073 = 3.95 and urgentBright #b85a55 = 2.70, so its guard substitutes vendor #8fd88f / #ff8a80 — the last off-palette chrome. Accepted, for three reasons. (1) There is no cmux-only lever: cmux.json carries sidebarAppearance + workspaceColors and NO diff-status color keys — the diff viewer is the same unreachable tier-3 surface as the hardcoded cmux accent (#239). (2) The only reachable lever is slots 9/10, shared ANSI real estate feeding every terminal, Helix, Neovim, Zed, WezTerm and the web syntax roles tag/invalid/string — a blast radius wildly out of proportion to one glyph pair. (3) #122-B already ruled this exact question the other way round: when a red needed 4.5, the answer was a dedicated text-tier token (urgentText), NOT moving the existing bright. cmux's guard is enforcing our own floor for us; the cost is Hard rule #1 (off-palette hue) on two 12px glyphs whose meaning is carried by position and filename, never color alone. SUNSET/TRIGGER: if cmux ever exposes diff-status color keys, bind deleted → urgentText #e6a8a2 (6.12:1 on terminalBg ✓) and mint a lifted apothecary green for added (no dark green in the palette clears 4.5 on terminalBg today — successBright is 3.95). Do NOT mint that green speculatively: there is no consumer.
$notes.lightElevationDeferral: Lane-1 standing disposition v0.21.0 (#296, DEFERRED BY DESIGN — not un-scheduled by accident). ADR 0036 lifted the terminal canvas dark-only, so light still has terminalBg == bg, ansiBlack == bg (ADR 0001's invisible black, live in light), and inverted elevation (bgRaised is DARKER than bg). Nothing is broken: light renders byte-identical to before, and every light ratio in this round clears its floor.
